title: Co-op says cyber attack cost it £206m in sales
summary: The retailer's IT networks were infiltrated by hackers in April, leading to payment problems and shortages of goods in shops.

title: Denmark airport closes due to drones, two days after incursions in Copenhagen and Oslo
summary: Police say the drones over Aalborg airport followed a similar pattern to the ones that had halted flights at Copenhagen airport a few days earlier Denmark’s Aalborg airport was closed for hours due to drones in its airspace, local police said early on Thursday, two days after the country’s main Copenhagen airport was shut over drone sightings that rattled European aviation. Danish national police said the drones followed a similar pattern to the ones that had halted flights at Copenhagen airport for four hours a few days earlier . The country’s armed forces were also affected, as Aalborg airport is used as a military base, they added. Continue reading...
